bio_am: Ծնած է Մուսա Լեռ՝ 1895-ին։ 1915-ի Մուսա Լերան հերոսական դիմադրութեան երիտասարդ ղեկավարներէն։
bio_en: Movses Ter-Galustian was born at Musa Dagh in 1895 and joined the ARF as a youth. During the Genocide in 1915 he was one of the young leaders of the historic resistance of Musa Dagh. Evacuated to Egypt with thousands of Suedia Armenians, he worked to form the volunteer Armenian Legion under the French flag and fought in it against the Turkish army until the armistice of 1918. As a Legion officer he then served in Cilicia, organising self-defence against the Kemalist forces; he died in 1984.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death year from the obituary (Hairenik 29 Nov 1984).
